agent.notes: The change adds a cached bot.get_me() call and a 'skip saved messages' check to a Telegram userbot message handler. Install failed on both sides because the repo has no pyproject.toml or setup.py. Importing the userbot package needs a config file with MongoDB settings and builds a Telegram client. The handler also makes HTTP calls, sends Telegram messages and runs yt-dlp. Nothing meaningful is left to measure without faking the Telegram client and the network.
